problem: Skills could be interpreted as helpers outside the canonical Powerhouse completion loop, allowing useful execution to end without durable logging, documentation, learning writeback or next-worker discoverability.
rootCause: The universal learning/writeback contract explicitly governed chats, agents and workflows but did not name skills as a first-class execution capability with its own fail-closed terminal conditions.
implementation: Extend universal scope and invariant set to material skills.
Add skill_execution_contract with mandatory preflight, activity ledger, exact evidence identity, documentation, learning writeback, shared-context refresh and discoverability.
Document the rule in AGENTS.md and the intrinsic-loop operating document.
Extend the already-required universal learning/writeback regression suite instead of creating a parallel CI family.
prevention: A material skill is part of the same canonical Powerhouse loop, never a side-channel authority.
Local output without canonical log/docs/learning/readback is RECOVERABLE_INCOMPLETE.
Skill completion must be discoverable to the next chat, agent or skill through the existing preflight path.
